title: Anthropic's Amodei Says AI Development Needs to Slow Down
description:
The AI industry is confronting a growing tension between racing to build more powerful systems and concerns that those systems could become harder to understand and control. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend are Bloomberg Opinion Technology Columnist Parmy Olson and Bloomberg News Executive Editor Technology & Strategic Industries Mike Shepard. Olson and Shepard examine the commercial and national security forces driving development, the push for greater industry coordination and government oversight, and why meaningful guardrails remain difficult to establish.
